stitchTrim.note: A roll trim about the boom axis cannot move the stitch plane onto points lying along that axis; the trim is a yaw of the camera about e3 aligning the stitch plane with the root→tip chord (0.5 Hz low-pass, ±0.1 rad).

v3target.note: An inertially steady camera 1.4–1.6 m from the rider sees the rider’s own >1 Hz motion (≈75 mm RMS in short turns); keeping the tip on the pelvis path removes only the torso articulation.
